title: Peritumoral ultrasound machine learning score is weakly linked to breast cancer response
summary: Support vector machine classifiers for 1 to 7 mm peritumoral regions were developed on 1,716 pathologically confirmed lesions and tested against Miller-Payne response in 132 patients after neoadjuvant therapy. A higher 7 mm score was associated with lower Miller-Payne grade (OR 0.79 per 0.1 unit, Holm p=0.048), and the association attenuated in a refitted model. Subgroup tests were not significant after correction.
ai_technology: Support vector machine classifiers on multiscale peritumoral ultrasound regions
